scenes.title: Baarish ke Beech Ek Sach
narration: *Neem Courtyard ki chhat par baarish ki halki awaaz hai. Teen cups se chai ki bhaap uthti hai. Aira aur Elena apni feelings saaf keh chuki hain; ab dono jawab ke liye jagah chhodti hain.*
Aira: "Chai thandi ho sakti hai... baat ko jaldi bolna zaroori nahi."
*Elena cup ke paas rakha tissue seedha karti hai. Uski nazar Aira se milti hai; koi dushmani nahi, bas ek mushkil sach.*
Elena: "Jo bhi tum kehna chaho, hum sun sakte hain. Bas woh sach ho."
fallbackLines: *Baarish ki halki awaaz baat ke liye jagah chhodti hai.*
Elena: "Tum apni baat apne lafzon mein keh sakte ho."

choices.text: "Main pehle tum dono ki baat sunna chahta hoon."

memory: {{playerName}} asked to hear both women before giving a romantic answer; no preference stated.

choices.text: "Aira, abhi tumhe mujhse kya kehna hai?"

memory: {{playerName}} invited Aira to speak; listening was not a romantic commitment.

choices.text: "Elena, abhi tumhe mujhse kya kehna hai?"

memory: {{playerName}} invited Elena to speak; listening was not a romantic commitment.

choices.text: "Abhi mera jawab clear nahi hai. Kya hum boundaries par baat kar sakte hain?"

memory: {{playerName}} said his answer is not clear and asked to discuss boundaries; none agreed yet.
